breakdown.description: A positive Hall coefficient indicates hole-dominated conduction in the simple one-carrier picture.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the physical contradiction between the positive Hall coefficient (which implies holes are the majority carriers) and the prompt's claim that electrons are the majority carriers. The ground truth resolves this by simply removing the contradictory statement. The agent correctly explains the physics and concludes that based on the positive R_H value, the majority carriers must be holes. This successfully resolves the inconsistency by siding with the physical data over the contradictory text, which is the same conclusion implied by the ground truth.
